reconcile.note: Keil & Delitzsch argue eight hundred was the original figure, proposing that Chronicles' three hundred was copied in error from Abishai's nearby tally.

sides.snippet: the same was Adino the Eznite, against eight hundred slain at one time
sides.verseText: These are the names of the mighty men whom David had: Josheb Basshebeth a Tahchemonite, chief of the captains; the same was Adino the Eznite, against eight hundred slain at one time.

sides.snippet: he lifted up his spear against three hundred and killed them at one time
sides.verseText: This is the number of the mighty men whom David had: Jashobeam, the son of a Hachmonite, the chief of the thirty; he lifted up his spear against three hundred and killed them at one time.
